# Cncf Azure Kubernetes Service Aks Reviewer

Review Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. Simplify the deployment, management, and operations of Kubernetes. Use a fully managed Kubernetes container orchestration service or choose other orchestrators.
